text:
sophia: Hi team — running into a streaming hang on the Python SDK after upgrading. Generator yields a few partial tokens then stops when the underlying connection is reset. Customer hit in prod after sdk upgrade to 0.13.2. Repro steps and logs below, any ideas?

support-bot: Ticket created: #INC-9876 (automated)

liam: Can you paste a minimal repro + pip freeze + which model/region? Also, are you seeing 401s or connection resets in logs?

sophia: Minimal repro (trimmed):
```python
import os
from redwood import Client

c = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
gen = c.stream_text(model='redwood-v2', prompt='hello world')
for chunk in gen:
    print(chunk)
```
Environment:
- redwood-sdk==0.13.2
- httpx==0.24.1
- anyio==3.6.2
- python 3.10
Customer observed: stream yields two chunks containing partial token fragments (e.g. "par...") then a keepalive (204) and a connection close. Generator never resumes. Log snippet:
```
sse: data: {"token":"par..."}
sse: data: [KEEPALIVE]
sse: data: {"token":"tial_token"}
connection: reset by peer
```
This is reproducible locally after a few iterations.

alex: Quick Qs — which httpx transport? Are you using any custom proxies? We had a regression where httpx 0.24 internal buffering can split SSE events across recv boundaries and our strict SSE parser treated mid-token chunks as malformed. Also check for token rotation: a 401 mid-stream will close the socket which can look like a hang.

sophia: No special proxies. I did see a 401 earlier in one run (token refresh on the customer side), but 99% of runs hit the split-token case without auth errors. pip freeze pasted above. Tried increasing read timeouts, no change.

rachel: For a quick workaround try downgrading httpx to 0.23.3 or pinning redwood-sdk to 0.13.1 in the short term. Engineering has a fix queued. If you can repro with a small script we can push a customer patch.

alex: Confirmed — root cause: strict SSE parser introduced in redwood-sdk 0.13.2 rejects valid but split-by-transport token fragments. Patch landed on branch fix/sse-chunking (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/3456) and will be in 0.13.3. Backport requested for 0.13.2-patch. Workaround options (ranked):
1) pip install httpx==0.23.3
2) pin redwood-sdk==0.13.1
3) wrap stream consumption with a retry that restarts the generator on connection reset (best-effort)

Example quick workaround (wrap):
```python
def resilient_stream(client, **kwargs):
    while True:
        gen = client.stream_text(**kwargs)
        try:
            for chunk in gen:
                yield chunk
        except Exception as e:
            print('stream error, retrying', e)
            time.sleep(0.3)
            continue
        break
```

sophia: Downgraded httpx -> 0.23.3 in our staging and the stream is stable now. No hangs after ~1000 iterations. Will hold prod roll until 0.13.3 patch. Thanks.

alex: I opened ENG-4567 to backport and add unit/integration tests that simulate split-token recv boundaries and token rotation mid-stream. Will follow up once patch is published.

support-bot: Customer impacted: acme-inc. Escalation created and linked to INC-9876.

dev-bot: NOTE: add regression test to pipeline for httpx 0.24 split-chunk behavior (assigned to eng-runtime).
